services.name: Waterski
services.desc: 20-30 minutes per person About Our trained staff will take you on the protected waters of our inland marina and provide you with the experience of a lifetime. Our boats are top of the line Correct Craft Ski Nautiques which will allow you to enjoy your time on the warm waters in total comfort. Participants must be 12 years or older. First-time riders must pay a $10 lesson fee for hands-on instruction on the water to ensure Ages 12+

services.name: Banana Boat Ride
services.desc: The Banana Boat ride is definitely the activity you don’t want to miss out on! 20 minutes About Jump on our six person inflatable boat and have more fun than you ever imagined. You will ride out from the dock to the marina in our luxury ski nautique and then transfer to the Banana Boat. The Ski Nautique skippered by our USCG Certified Captain will tow you through the marina where you will hang on and try desperately not to fall off. If you do, it’s not a problem as all riders are provided with USCG life jackets and the boat captain will immediately pick you up and continue on this Ages 4+

services.name: Bumper Tube Ride
services.desc: 15 minutes About Our luxury ski nautique skippered by our USCG Certified Captain will take you out to the marina and provide you with the ride of your vacation. Hang on while you jump the wake and your body bounces up and down, the fun part is rolling into the refreshing marina waters when you can’t hold on any longer. Riders must be 4 years or For those who like a little more speed and adventure then it's the bumper tube ride for you.

services.name: Wakeboarding
services.desc: 30 minutes per person About Our professional instructors make wakeboarding fun and easy to learn for all, no matter what your skill level. For those who are experienced you already know the thrill of wakeboarding and riding the waters in the tropical setting of Koko Marina will be a memory that will last a lifetime. Lesson Carve up the water and ride the wake behind our luxury Nautiques complete with air towers.

services.name: Parasailing
services.desc: Our Most Popular Activity! Ages 5+ 1 Hour Check-in 30 minutes prior to the activity Available Times About Up to 1,000 feet of tow-line allows you and a friend to enjoy perfect views of Diamond Head from Oahu’s south shore. Choose the length that will satisfy your craving for adventure: 700 feet, 850 feet, or 1,000 feet. Booking Notes All price is per person Shared Boat Tour 1 hour (not flight time) Flight is tandem or triple (no single) Observer option: Sitting on the boat and watch (not parasailing), no age limit What to Wear Swimsuit, board shorts, rash guard or any Parasail over Oahu

Next up is the Bumper Tube where up to four participants can enjoy an adrenaline pumping ride, as the tube races across the water and jumps the wake. A great water sports combo suitable for all, young and Banana boat & bumper tube • Ages 4+

This is not a guided tour. We also have water and snacks for your enjoyment.
